title: Fixed Open-Front Stepped Prism and Lamp Apparatus
description: One newly authored complete static lighthouse-optic-style display apparatus, separate from any building. A whole grounded stepped pedestal and four rising struts support two complete open carrier rings with four slender posts. Three full circular rimmed lens-style panels have continuous rear faces and actual concentric stepped front relief; two continuous rear half-annular prism-style bands have real stepped faces, inner walls and exposed cut ends. The entire front is intentionally left open in a fixed cutaway arrangement to show an independently supported complete inert central lamp body and cap. This is not the old lighthouse lantern room extracted or enlarged: that earlier building contains only an ordinary solid small lamp, not this surrounding stepped-panel and prism-band assembly. Nor is it the film-history lantern with a box chamber, chimney, crossing slide and long forward lens barrel. All visible geometry newly authored, with no old lamp, enclosure or camera mesh imported. Four opaque constant untextured PBR materials; the pale lens-like surfaces do not transmit or refract. One complete prop zero scenes, metres Z up and horizontal-bounds-centred finite ground datum. Artistic static cutaway only: no historical/optical prescription accuracy, Fresnel performance, focusing, light output, emission, rotation, navigation, electrical power, fuel, heat, installation, structural rating or maritime safety capability. Rigging animation and interaction not made.
